title: Primordials — Living Ecosystem
description:
A real ecosystem that breathes on your desktop. Predator-prey dynamics in real-time. 60 FPS, low CPU, fully procedural.

Six biomes:
- Algae Bloom (default)
- Deep Sea
- Primordial Soup
- Tundra
- Coral Reef
- Volcanic Vent

Built on a custom C++23 ECS engine. Open source under MIT.

GitHub: github.com/SahilKhutey/Primodials
Discord: discord.gg/primordials
